description: Known news sources for Official (Pro) listings and explicitly allowlisted curated Community full-listing pilots. Community full listings are never eligible unless listingMode is curated-full-pilot.

org:2060.name: 2060.io
org:2060.notes: No public blog or RSS on the homepage. GitHub org atom had no usable entries in the first harvest.

org:bhutan-ndi.name: Bhutan NDI
org:bhutan-ndi.notes: Dedicated first-party Bhutan NDI news. No current item falls inside the 60-day pilot window.

org:credenco.name: Credenco
org:credenco.notes: Homepage and /news are a JS app. English article URLs are in sitemap.xml as /news/{slug}. Open the rendered /news index in a browser; do not trust the empty HTML shell.

org:czechia.name: Czech Government
org:czechia.notes: Use only stable first-party eDoklady article URLs. Inline index updates without a permanent article URL are not publishable.

org:espuni.name: espuni
org:espuni.notes: Organization listing has no website field. Site was flaky (connection reset) during harvest.

org:ethiopia.name: National ID Program Ethiopia
org:ethiopia.notes: Use only first-party Fayda or National ID Program articles with a stable URL and explicit publication date.

org:fides.name: FIDES Labs
org:fides.notes: Feed and news URLs returned 403 to automated clients.

org:finland.name: Finnish Government
org:finland.notes: The DVV host is broad. Publish only press releases explicitly about Finland's EUDI Wallet or Suomi.fi Wallet; never general DVV news.

org:germany.name: German Government
org:germany.notes: Pilot source is dedicated to Germany's EUDI Wallet programme. Reject the generic /en/news/article CMS placeholder and LinkedIn-only destinations.

org:ilabs.name: iLabs
org:ilabs.notes: Marketing SPA. /feed and /blog return 200 HTML, not RSS.

org:india.name: India Government
org:india.notes: Dedicated DigiLocker blog. Keep only posts with a verifiable publication date inside the pilot window.

org:imda.name: Infocomm Media Development Authority
org:imda.notes: Use only the dedicated first-party TradeTrust source. Never harvest IMDA's general news stream.

org:kingdom-of-belgium-federal-governmen.name: Belgian Federal Government
org:kingdom-of-belgium-federal-governmen.notes: Technical Belgian eID releases only. Do not use general federal-government news; no current release falls inside the 60-day window.

org:minisuomi.name: Mini-Suomi
org:minisuomi.notes: Dedicated Mini-Wallet domain. It currently exposes no stable, dated news articles, so the pilot remains empty.

org:netherlands.name: Dutch Government
org:netherlands.notes: Use only first-party EDI-Stelsel NL articles about digital identity and wallets; never general Dutch-government news.

org:sphereon.name: Sphereon
org:sphereon.notes: WordPress /feed exists but only contained Hello world! in the first harvest. GitHub releases were older than 90 days.

org:uncefact.name: UN/CEFACT
org:uncefact.notes: UN Transparency Protocol updates only. Table rows without a distinct stable URL are not publishable news items.

org:verana.name: Verana
org:verana.notes: No blog. GitHub tags are frequent -dev prereleases; do not treat those as listing news.

org:webuild.name: WE BUILD Consortium
org:webuild.notes: Dedicated first-party consortium news source for the EUDI Wallet and European Business Wallet large-scale pilot.
